connected_findings.classification: Existing earlier lens findings reconnected to 95e; preserve individual first-contract perspectives and leave global alias decision central.
connected_findings.trace: main.rs:435–440 to_bytes(body,16 MiB) failure returns original response parts and an empty body, dropping the source cause and retaining the prior HTTP status/headers; this is conditional on a stream or limit error. For negotiated GET, strategic-navigation.js:129–148 parses the body and displays a failure notice if #strategic-page is absent; response.text() failure is caught at 175–180. For negotiated POST rerender, main.rs:357–369 requires root and changes failure to 502; strategic-mutations.js:94–118 reports a failure. These consumer safeguards do not restore cause or truthful GET status; do not claim observed player impact or runtime transport behavior.
connected_findings.future_repair_direction: After exhaustive audit and authorization, carry or contextualize body-read failure to an appropriate failure response and consistent replacement headers, preserving legitimate complete root responses and POST/GET distinctions; native transport, all consumers and alias decisions remain open.

connected_findings.classification: Existing prior conditional finding independently reconnected to current producer and consumer, not a new unique historical finding.
connected_findings.trace: inventory_medical.rs:707–727 queries charts for both observer and patient and returns unavailable on query failure. When viewer=self or authorized observations exist, 728–736 queries administration history but unwrap_or_default converts query Err to an empty vector. With the clock available, 740–764 calls medical::sanitize, which sets unavailable=false at medical.rs:210–223 and derives no active administrations from the empty vector. character_health.rs:1159–1172 shows Current medication only if the active vector is nonempty. Therefore on this conditional failed authorized-history request, missing data is indistinguishable from successfully empty history; chart failure, unauthorized access and missing clock are separate branches. No actual database error or patient impact was observed.
connected_findings.future_repair_direction: Represent history availability separately or propagate a contextual failure through the observer-authorized presentation, retaining fail-closed privacy and a true successful empty history. Reconcile history/timeline/active-control shared scope and later acceptance for chart Ok/history Err, true empty, denied observer and absent clock.

lens_notes.unfinished_producers: Traced selected chart/history query to sanitized presentation and template, selected typed Storefront to HTTP service path, and normal checked dose writers to gateway DTO; other producers and native boundaries remain open.
lens_notes.existing_owners: DoseMilliunits, StrategicMinute, SettlementVenueKind, Storefront and LocationKind have distinct roles; compare typed production and raw HTTP/native representations with exact admissions before proposing unification.
lens_notes.admission: Unknown service raw string triggers expect; selected typed Storefront values all map. Backend dose expect has selected writer proofs. Medical malformed-row and projection policies remain open.
lens_notes.operations: No body-read error result survives GET fragment transformation; q178/q456 reconnect. Query failures and empty vectors collapse for medication history q193; dates, sort and zero-saturation need wider obligations.
lens_notes.aggregates: Observer/patient authorization, chart/history availability, active course and clock have distinct states; boolean unavailable cannot describe the selected mixed-success state. Do not conflate unauthorized with failed.
lens_notes.wrong_or_duplicate_owners: Venue identity, service identity, chapter identity and public-square presence differ; no automatic alias solely due string mapping. Renderer/HTTP tokens remain boundary protocols pending independent owner analysis.
lens_notes.redundant_authority: Regional latest and concealed aggregate have a logically coupled unreachable else computation; design intent open. Active administrations derive from history and current time; authority is not established duplicate solely by projection.
lens_notes.behavior_preservation: All three exact bodies match historical revision; connected source and UI behavior may differ. Keep intentional fallback/error branches and signed/quantized semantics while deciding remediation.
lens_notes.enum_state_shape: LocationKind and CorpseActionKind are closed enums; MedicalPresentation unavailable with administration vectors cannot express history query failure independently of available chart. Actual stronger state shape requires reconciled product policy.
lens_notes.derivability: No material manual trait boilerplate replacement proven in the three bodies; LocationKind Display/FromStr operate HTTP canonical names and CorpseAction tag parallels Serde but serve explicit boundary functions.
lens_notes.type_granularity: Dose accepts zero and max while real administration writes require positive; typed Storefront and physical venue are different concepts. Screen/ID fields need exact upstream ownership.
lens_notes.raw_strings: Static URL/header/HTML tokens are native protocol, not automatic primitive-string violations. Service strings, disease/preparation IDs and custom navigation header vocabulary remain scoped owner questions.
lens_notes.raw_primitives: Chart basis-point fields, physiology band, vector cardinalities, raw u32 doses and time are distinct roles; selected typed owners and admission already traced, but backend range/all consumers remain incomplete.
